title: A Glasshouse for the Weather
author: Ulyana Oyelaran
blurb: Mara Blackwood, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
